code: local rp=RaycastParams.new() rp.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include rp.FilterDescendantsInstances={workspace.Terrain} rp.IgnoreWater=false local rows={} for z=-3500,3500,100 do local r={} for x=-3500,3500,100 do local h=workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x,1200,z),Vector3.new(0,-1400,0),rp) if h then local w=(h.Material==Enum.Material.Water) and 'w' or '' table.insert(r,math.floor(h.Position.Y)..w) else table.insert(r,'n') end end table.insert(rows,table.concat(r,',')) end return table.concat(rows,';')
